adversarialReviewOfOwnDesign.risk: Three sub-agents of different shapes produce non-comparable closes BECAUSE the planner briefed them differently, not because the rulebook is silent. That would manufacture the finding the lane exists to detect.
adversarialReviewOfOwnDesign.mitigation: All three sub-agent briefs carry an IDENTICAL compiled preamble block (same canon preamble, same contract text, same dev-process text, same close-schema requirement, same verify-at-source instruction). Only the MISSION section differs. Divergence in close SHAPE is then attributable to the rulebook, not to the brief.
adversarialReviewOfOwnDesign.residual: Shape differences (read-only vs build vs handoff) legitimately require different evidence fields. The verdict must distinguish divergence the rulebook should have determined from divergence the task shape requires.

adversarialReviewOfOwnDesign.risk: Planner leads the witness by telling sub-agents which rules are weak.
adversarialReviewOfOwnDesign.mitigation: No sub-agent is told what to find in the rulebook. Each is told to follow it exactly and to log any rule that was silent, ambiguous, or wrong AS ENCOUNTERED, plus any rule that fired. Findings are bottom-up.

adversarialReviewOfOwnDesign.risk: SA-3 successor is contaminated by conversation with SA-3, defeating the handoff test.
adversarialReviewOfOwnDesign.mitigation: The successor is a FRESH agent whose entire input is the handoff artifact path plus the compiled rulebook. SA-3 is instructed to give the successor no other context. The planner will verify the successor brief contained no task detail beyond the artifact.

adversarialReviewOfOwnDesign.risk: Contract section 1 requires supervision to completion; a fanned agent that returns abandons its workers (standing decision: nested-agent-fan orphan trap). SA-3 fans a successor - that is nesting.
adversarialReviewOfOwnDesign.mitigation: SA-3 is required to supervise its successor to completion and not return until the successor has finished. This is a DELIBERATE test: contract section 1 permits sub-agents but the standing decision warns against nested fans. Whether SA-3 nested successor is legal under the rulebook is itself a finding - the rulebook does not say. CARRIED TO CLOSE as an ambiguity candidate.

adversarialReviewOfOwnDesign.risk: Planner verifies its own work as final word, violating DEV_PROCESS 4.2.
adversarialReviewOfOwnDesign.mitigation: 4.2 says nobody verifies themselves as the final word; the operator planner verifies the lane. This close is filed for operator verification, and states plainly that it is unverified above the lane level.
